title: 3367. Maximize Sum of Weights after Edge Removals

examples.explanation: Node 2 has edges with 3 other nodes. We remove the edge [0, 2, 2], ensuring that no node has edges with more than k = 2 nodes. The sum of weights is 22, and we can't achieve a greater sum. Thus, the answer is 22.
Since no node has edges connecting it to more than k = 3 nodes, we don't remove any edges. The sum of weights is 65. Thus, the answer is 65.
